title: Mother and Daughters in Park, 1940s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming 1940s outdoor portrait featuring a smiling woman and two young girls embracing in a sunlit park surrounded by foliage. The woman wears a sailor-inspired top with a front neck bow and a matching cap, while the girls wear classic mid-century summer clothing. The reverse side features handwritten names reading 'Blanche - Pam' along with a photo print number stamp.
